textual.context: Presented as the speaker's personal update and positive review of the system, with a promotional invitation to join. The speaker also compares the stated return with banks and other investment plans.
textual.potential_relevance: A claimed recurring return is directly linked to investing money and to an invitation to join through an external description link, requiring later assessment of the offer, conditions and destination.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the bonus, return rate, investment system, link destination or claimed results are genuine, guaranteed or available to viewers. The records also do not show where funds go or whether recruitment produces compensation.

visual.observation: A logged-in cryptocurrency dashboard visibly shows a team and referral structure, including “Total Team Members 11,” “Direct Referrals 2,” “Left Team 10,” “Right Team 1,” and a “Binary Bonuses” panel labeled “Not Binary Qualified” with left/right counts, alongside trading and bonus balances.
visual.context: The relationship between the referral/team structure and displayed binary and trading bonus categories is visible, but no explicit instruction to recruit or perform another action appears in the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: The interface associates member recruitment or placement in left/right teams with bonus qualification and displays cryptocurrency-related balances, which conditionally merits review as a recruitment-linked reward structure.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish that viewers are being solicited, required to recruit, required to pay or transfer assets, or that any displayed balance represents an actual payout or loss.

visual_context_notes.observation: The dashboard is labeled “Paid Member” and includes an “OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT” stating that the platform focuses on trading and aims to provide a “conservative, safe and sustainable trading experience” using an algorithm.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes an investment-linked opportunity by claiming approximately 0.5% daily, or 15% monthly, profit after a personal investment update and inviting viewers to join their team through a description link. The displayed dashboard includes team and referral counts and trading-related balances, but the claimed rate, payouts, link destination, and viewer outcomes are not verified.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links their stated capital investment and bonus to a trading plan, extrapolates a recurring return, and says they will add to that investment; the dashboard also displays a Trading Pool Balance. These are reported claims and displayed figures, not verified payouts.
